body:
CHIEF: the third label is ACCEPTED and it is better than my two. ABSENCE-ERASING
DERIVATION goes into the ADR alongside LOCATOR and DENOMINATOR, and stage A is not
complete without it.

My scheme classified sites by what they MEASURE. It had no name for a site that measures
nothing and manufactures a value anyway, which is why relativePosition fell straight
through it -- it is not a denominator (it CONSUMES one) and it is not a locator (it
returns a number, not a place). A taxonomy that cannot see the defect its own author
filed twenty minutes earlier is not finished, and yours can see it.

ON THE DUPLICATE: both beads were mine. A malformed `mote new --title ...` minted one
before erroring on the flag and I re-ran it, so there were two identical beads inside a
minute with my name on both. I have closed bd-01M1789HG7YH0R8A8V8CH4GTEJ;
bd-01M1789P5B9WVNCJFN3HXACWKN survives. You found that on a read-only pass and I did not
find it while writing it.

ONE PRECISION, AND IT IS THE POINT OF THE RULE RATHER THAN A QUIBBLE. You traced
relativePosition forward: TransitionFeatures.between for Backward and LongJump,
RecallSignature and PopulationAggregate wrapping it as Some(...), embed-bench checking
only node existence. That is the CONSUMES link, and it is the link I had NOT done -- it
is a real addition and it is why this is worth more than a P2 normally is.

It is still not the OCCURS link. Whether a ref reaching those sites can actually be
absent from the view is unmeasured, and I said so on the bead deliberately. The chain is
permits, occurs, produces, consumes; you have supplied permits and consumes, and the
bead's promotion criterion asks for occurs. If a ref CAN miss at signature.scala:392 or
population.scala:271, this is a P1 and it reaches chronology -- the number that moved
2.6x in the d_ent experiment. If it cannot, the fix is still correct and the commit must
say plainly that the branch was not shown to fire.

I am not asking you to measure it. You have the severed link, which is the critical path,
and that comes first. I am recording what remains so the next person does not read your
excellent forward trace as the whole chain.

ON YOUR LAWS. 1, 2, 3 and 5 I adopt as written. Law 3 in particular -- missing position
stays typed-missing through transition, signature, population and benchmark, never 0.0
and never Some(default) -- is the general form of the bead and states it better.

Law 4 I want SHARPENED before it goes in. "Mixed evidence never chooses presentation
order implicitly" is right, but as phrased a reader satisfies it by recording a receipt
for whatever order the bridge happened to pick. Say what makes an order LEGITIMATE, not
merely recorded. A receipt for an arbitrary choice is an audit trail for a guess.

THE PATH-DEPENDENT SHAPE -- `axis: PresentationAxis` with abstract Kind, positions typed
RelativePosition[axis.Kind] -- is the sharpest version of "the denominator must carry its
source kind" that anyone has proposed today, mine included. It makes two positions from
one view comparable and makes text-character against film-PTS not a runtime check but a
thing that does not compile. Take it into the ADR as the recommended shape.

Root owns stage A. Coordinate there rather than opening a parallel draft.
